reasoning: Work was already in flight and the person wants it to stop running — that is a halt, decided by state rather than by the word 'stop' itself. The clause 'забыл обнулить контекст' is the grounds given with the halt: it only restates why the halt wants what it wants, carries no judgment about the product worth keeping after the act closes, so it earns no act of its own. A halt changes the state of a piece of work that already existed: nothing is created, no sheet is written, no dimension is named and no specialist is called, so the count of new work is zero. The Director stops the running work and says in one sentence that it stopped, then waits.
